description: This source file implements core file handling operations for a version control system, including directory creation, file removal, reading blobs, handling checkout entries, and managing submodules. It appears to be part of the internal mechanics of a git-like system, dealing with checkout and filesystem synchronization.

methods.name: void create_directories(const char * path,int path_len,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Creates nested directories specified in the given path, handling existing directories and symlinks, with optional force removal.

methods.name: void remove_subtree(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Recursively removes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: int create_file(const char * path,unsigned int mode)
methods.description: Creates a new file with specified mode, returning the file descriptor.

methods.name: void * read_blob_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,size_t * size)
methods.description: Reads the blob object corresponding to a cache entry and returns its data.

methods.name: int open_output_fd(char * path,const struct cache_entry * ce,int to_tempfile)
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor for output, using temp filenames when needed.

methods.name: int fstat_checkout_output(int fd,const struct checkout * state,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Performs a reliable fstat on the checkout output fd if conditions permit.

methods.name: int streaming_write_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct stream_filter * filter,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * fstat_done,struct stat * statbuf)
methods.description: Streams a blob entry directly to a file descriptor, handling errors.

methods.name: void enable_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Initializes delayed checkout state, used for deferred content processing.

methods.name: int remove_available_paths(struct string_list_item * item,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Callback to remove available paths from the list, used during delayed checkout filtering.

methods.name: int string_is_not_null(struct string_list_item * item,void * data UNUSED)
methods.description: Filter callback to check if a string list item is non-null.

methods.name: int finish_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state,int show_progress)
methods.description: Finalizes delayed checkout operations, applying filters and updating the index.

methods.name: void update_ce_after_write(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Updates cache entry metadata after writing to the filesystem.

methods.name: int write_entry(struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * nr_checkouts)
methods.description: Handles writing different types of cache entries (files, symlinks, submodules) to disk.

methods.name: int check_path(const char * path,int len,struct stat * st,int skiplen)
methods.description: Performs a structured stat on a path, avoiding symlinks in specific parts.

methods.name: void mark_colliding_entries(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Marks cache entries that have path collisions or inode conflicts.

methods.name: int checkout_entry_ca(struct cache_entry * ce,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,char * topath,int * nr_checkouts)
methods.description: Performs checkout of a cache entry with optional path output and attribute conversion.

methods.name: void unlink_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,const char * super_prefix)
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from the filesystem, handling submodules and path cleanup.

methods.name: int remove_or_warn(unsigned int mode,const char * file)
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, emitting warnings if needed.
